Factory admission is Ready/controller-only; worker operations do not read mutable domain phase. External B3/B4 stop/join and provider destruction are mandatory before domain close; no automatic cancellation or unload proof.

Existing malloc06a308 normalizes zero and uses flags0. Existing0634b0 supplies explicit retry. Selected compiler bad_alloc/bad_array_new_length and PTRDIFF_MAX support boundary are documented, not native EH proof.

Independent reviewer identified a live allocation ticket erased if post-success commit locking throws. Final code keeps observed_pointer outside the try; unknown or known-success post-call exceptions preserve ownership and poison. A second recovery-lock failure leaves the reserved busy ticket terminal. This is static review; std::mutex failure was not dynamically forced.

Existing0668c0 maps real failure into same-domain errno. The stack observer distinguishes failed/successful/unknown HeapFree outcome; known failure retains ownership for explicit retry; successful free removes the ticket; unknown outcome remains poisoned.

The final captured flag preserves the recorded post-source SDK LastError through local exception construction and bookkeeping. Known free-failure test asserts ACCESS_DENIED and errno13 before retry. Unknown source exceptions retain their observed catch-time boundary.

Stable list tickets are reserved under a mutex before native allocation. The gate is released around native APIs/new handlers. Per-ticket busy state rejects simultaneous double release; foreign and cross-provider pointers are outside the supported ownership domain.

SourceServices binds exactly allocation/deallocation and finalguard. Retained017a30 assembly is RET0; this supplies the observed no-op without claiming PE CFG implementation. Remaining6 policies still go to lower ownership.

UTF8widen uses existing strict two-pass conversion with explicit lengths and first-pass size. Narrowpath selects actual filesystem codepage before empty input. Relative resolution reuses existing absolute/parent/join algorithms. No known-folder or guessed fallback substitution.

corrected_actionable_findings: post-source SDK LastError not overwritten by local exception bookkeeping
limits: Memory operations require controller or workers of the same initialized recovered PTD domain; foreign-thread fallback/OOM concurrency remains unproven.
Direct users must stop admission and join every worker/FLS destructor before provider destruction. Root lease is not a worker join.
Unknown SDK C++ exceptions are test-only injected hostile boundaries; real callbacks must obey nonthrowing Win32 outcome contracts.
Bookkeeping, ownership rejection and portable exceptions are explicitly selected rebuilt policies, not original ABI/fault equivalence.
Containing image remains mapped for own tests; successful DLL unload or loader-lock-safe entry/shutdown was not tested.
